title: Unbounded channel growth
summary: Using unbounded channels where producer speed can exceed consumer capacity.
rationale: Unbounded queues hide backpressure and can convert traffic spikes into memory exhaustion.

detection.notes: Detect unbounded_channel or unbounded MPSC patterns in service paths.

impact.notes: Impact increases in hot paths, large inputs, high-concurrency services, build pipelines, or repeated request paths.

remediation.guidance: Use bounded channels, explicit backpressure, dropping policies, or admission control.
remediation.tradeoffs: Bounded queues force product decisions about loss, latency, or rejection behavior.
